purpose: Recover provenance-quality Hyperliquid historical boundary price evidence after the official candleSnapshot REST endpoint proved retention-limited.

selection_rule.entry_price_proxy: Use the first valid full-depth L2 snapshot timestamp at or after 2024-09-01T00:00:00Z; compute native best-bid/best-ask midpoint. Fail closed if no snapshot occurs within the first 60 seconds of the frozen entry hour.
selection_rule.exit_price_proxy: Use the last valid full-depth L2 snapshot timestamp at or before 2025-12-31T23:59:59.999Z; compute native best-bid/best-ask midpoint. Fail closed if no snapshot occurs within the final 60 seconds of the frozen exit hour.

why_l2_midpoint: The frozen Run02 candle source is no longer retained by the official REST API. Official historical L2 is documented by Hyperliquid and permits deterministic boundary valuation while historical executable-return claims remain blocked under G07.
decision_rule: If all four official archive files exist and the frozen boundary-selection rules produce unique valid midpoint evidence, Run02 may be re-issued as Run02B with official archive provenance. Otherwise full mechanism replication remains REPLICATION_INCONCLUSIVE unless another official source is prospectively frozen before viewing basis outcomes.
